name: Pink Elephants
review:
The original 4,096-ways game where tribal minions search for a magical peanut. A mystery scatter leads to free spins with symbol transformation and retriggers.

It's simpler than the sequels but still fun, with the transformations doing the heavy lifting in the bonus. High volatility, 8,200x cap, 96.1% RTP. A good place to start before trying the newer games.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
